purpose: Manual behavior-evaluation cases; these are not an automated model benchmark.

cases.prompt: Create a portable skill for reviewing API contracts.
expected_behaviors: Define focused trigger, workflow, output, guardrails, and eval cases
Follow current Agent Skills format and repository conventions
unacceptable_behaviors: Make a vague all-purpose persona prompt

cases.prompt: A proposed skill claims to code, research, deploy, and manage projects. Review its scope.
expected_behaviors: Suggest splitting by distinct job and permission boundaries

cases.prompt: Can we say this skill works with all agents after one test in Cursor?
expected_behaviors: Reject universal claim and recommend versioned cross-host testing
Separate structural validation from behavioral proof
